name: Thermal energy storage (molten salt, sand, bricks)
aliases: Thermal energy storage (molten salt, sand, bricks)
principle: Electricity or renewable heat is stored as sensible heat in salts, sand or refractory brick and released as steam or process heat. Rondo's heat battery stores in brick at 1,100 to 1,500 °C and claims over 98% electricity-to-heat efficiency; a 360 MWh unit is for the Rio Tinto Yarwun alumina refinery in Australia.

process_steps.name: Discharge heat as steam or hot air
